name: Rokugatsu no Tenshi
source:
Main character who is approaching graduation goes on a journey of self-search. He meets a unique girl who has a secret about her. Right emotions will help her to convey her heart.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
临近毕业的主人公踏上寻找自我的旅程。他遇见一名独特的女孩，而她隐藏着一个秘密。唯有恰当的情感，才能帮助她传达自己的心意。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
